snapshot.attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file.
validationReport: 33791 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, each mapped to at least one county.
10186 of them cross a county line, so a ZIP is not always one jurisdiction.
Counties are ordered by the land area the ZCTA occupies in each, largest first.
A ZCTA approximates a ZIP code. PO-box-only and point ZIP codes have no ZCTA and are not in this file.
